text:
noa (PM): Quick decision log for Observe guardrails before tomorrow's rollout. Need final owners, acceptance thresholds, and explicit rollback triggers. Keep this thread as the single source of truth.

reid (Eng): Engineering note: main exposure is trace write amplification during error storms. Runtime will have token-bucket + backpressure. Default sampling will bias errors.

claire (SRE): On last staging run a short error burst inflated trace writes ~5x. Proposal: bounded async buffer + auto-throttle policy that reduces success sampling when trace_queue > 2.5k.

mina (Platform): Proposed canary config (immutable for canary):
```yaml
observe_defaults:
  success_sampling: 1%
  error_capture: 100%
  regional_cap: 150 # traces/min/region
  redact_rules: ["email","account_id"]
  tenant_opt_in: true
```
Tenant opt-in flag: tenant.observe_full_traces = true.

olga (Solutions): Customer asks: per-tenant cost tiles + exportable trace snippets for postmortems. FinTech requires signed redaction attestation before enabling.

reid (Eng): Runtime will emit these metrics for gating: `observe.queue_len`, `observe.write_p95_ms`, `observe.limiter.dropped`, and `observe.trace_cost_delta_pct`. I'll add a token-bucket and a dynamic knob to lower success_sampling if queue > threshold.

noa (PM): Acceptance gates to progress past 10% -> 50% (must all be green):
- Dashboards: error-by-model and per-tenant cost tile visible and refresh within 3m
- Traces: sampling rules enforced; tenant overrides respected; redaction tests pass for FinCust vectors
- Perf: p95 console call latency <= 620ms across canary window
- Ops: observe.queue_len < 3k and observe.write_p95_ms < 350ms
- Cost: rolling-2h trace-induced cost delta <= 11% vs baseline

claire (SRE): Automated rollback triggers:
- observe.queue_len > 5k OR
- p95 latency increase > 15% sustained for 5m OR
- any customer redaction test fails for a tenant that has opt-in enabled
If triggered, we flip feature flag off and page oncall.

mina (Platform): Owners: dashboards=olga, runtime=reid, platform infra=mina, ops=claire. I'll bake the REDACT_RULES env and tenant API today.

olga (Solutions): I'll draft customer-facing opt-in emails and the FinCust attestation template. We won't enable opt-in for FinCust without signature.

reid (Eng): Action items (ETA EOD): 1) token-bucket limiter + `observe.limiter.dropped` metric, 2) backpressure hook that lowers success_sampling on queue pressure, 3) unit tests for redaction sanitizer.

claire (SRE): I'll schedule a 45m synthetic during canary: 30m steady traffic + 15m injected error spikes. I'll post the run link and gating panel snapshot here. Fail if any gate breached.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 07:40 PT -> rolling to 10% traffic.

noa (PM): Rollout cadence: canary (10%) -> observe 45m -> evaluate gates -> 50% for 2h if green -> full. Post PRs, dashboard links, and synthetic logs here during the window. This thread is canonical for the launch decision. :white_check_mark:
